integrity: The claimed infinite-family result follows from an explicit Fourier-sector proof. Integer projector and independent Krylov computations verify dimensions three through ten but are not substituted for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Uniform nonzero nearest-neighbor hopping, no coherent interaction and strictly positive collision loss at every site are required; no finite-time relaxation rate or robustness theorem is asserted. An earlier unindexed two-body observability or dissipative lattice formula remains a historical-priority risk.
title: Exact collision-loss dark projector for two quantum walkers on a cycle
